onboarding.welcomeTitle: ⭐ Welcome to Star Hunter | Last Order!
onboarding.dmMessage: Welcome to **{server}**, {name}! Head to {rules} and click **I agree** to unlock the server. 🌟
rules: Be respectful. No harassment, hate speech, or personal attacks.
No cheating, exploits, or selling accounts/items.
Keep channels on topic. Use the right channel for LFG, trading, and bugs.
No spam or self-promotion without staff permission.
English and Spanish are both welcome. Use the translated channels to talk across languages.
Staff decisions are final. Open a ticket if you have a problem.

rolePicker.title: 🎭 Pick your roles
rolePicker.description: Choose your language so you see the right channels, then tell us how you play. Click again to remove a role.
